items.title: Warby Parker Sets Sights On Smart Glasses Launch
items.summary: Designer eyewear firm Warby Parker will begin taking preorders on Nov. 12 for its first smart glasses, branded Intelligent Eyewear.

items.title: Microsoft Is Winding Down Oracle Deal to Rent AI Cloud Capacity
items.summary: Microsoft Corp. is winding down an arrangement to rent AI computing from Oracle Corp., part of a larger reassessment of billions of dollars in cloud partnerships.
